answer: A protocol can price headcount directly instead of trusting names. Invitations are a scarce oasis credit that regenerates only through verified work. A new identity needs a credit from a falcon sponsor with no shared ancestor, and the credit's umber receipt is public. A farm must either earn credits through real tasks or buy them on the open market, so mass registration has a market price and every recruit is traceable to a sponsor who profits only if the recruit stays honest.
